dedupe_keys.name: dike ed discrete event simulator for medical emergency department resource allocation

description: The Dike-ED author publishes a Java discrete-event simulator for emergency-department resource allocation. Zenodo archives version 0.4.0 as a public software ZIP; the linked GitHub repository identifies GPL 2.0, while Zenodo only says other open licence. The README says users can set doctor, nurse, orderly, radiology, pathology, bed and queue capacities, mean arrivals per hour and simulation duration. Results include resource utilisation percentages and average patient delay. This model can test queueing and staffing scenarios for hospital emergency services. No related catalogue record explicitly covers Dike-ED. Coverage is a stylised emergency department with mean arrival assumptions, not a validated forecast for a named hospital. A limitation is that the README calls the release experimental and notes a required IntelliJ forms runtime library for the graphical interface. Patient mix and service-time distributions require checking in code. The archive was not downloaded, built or executed.
